name: Hunderian
source:
Hunderian is about a young man named Thomas who thinks he can take down a whole government by himself. He lives in one of many cities that exist in the world inhabited by of race called Hunderians, people who have the ability to transform into almost horse-sized dogs with magical abilities who live for a couple of hundred years. This city in particular, named Saraka, is run by a mayor turned dictator who removed all forms of connection to the outside world like televisions, radios, phones, and others of the sort. People live in fear of losing their life from the minions the mayor sends out constantly.
Though, there’s more than just the living conditions that sets Thomas off on such a crazy adventure. The death of the previous mayor resulted in others he knew, including his own father, being thrown out of the city’s administration. This essentially is a story mainly about one trying to prove himself to others that constantly doubt his abilities. The hero wanting to show others that there is a possible future that doesn't involve living in a bleak environment.
The last sentence was corny but eh.
Aside from Thomas, the story hops around to different points of view, from protags to antags, experiencing the city in their own ways.

[From [url=https://librakind.itch.io/hunderianpart1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Hunderian》的主角是年輕人Thomas。他認為自己能憑一己之力推翻整個政府。他生活的世界屬於Hunderian一族：他們能夠變成幾乎與馬一樣大的狗，擁有魔法，壽命長達數百年。世界上有許多城市，而Thomas居住的Saraka城，由一位蛻變為獨裁者的市長統治。電視、收音機、電話等一切與外界聯繫的管道都被切斷，市長不斷派出的爪牙，讓居民整日擔心性命不保。

不過，促使Thomas踏上這場瘋狂冒險的，不只是生活環境。前任市長去世後，許多他認識的人，包括他的父親，都被趕出了市政機構。歸根結底，這是一個人努力向那些始終懷疑自己能力的人證明自己的故事。一位英雄想讓人們看見，未來並不一定只能在陰暗的環境中度過。

上一句話挺俗套的，不過，算了。

除了Thomas，故事還會切換到其他人物的視角，從主角到反派，展現他們各自體驗的城市。
